rules: Budget one long time-series term per candidate. A single 126d fundamental delta was accepted (1.589), but two 126d fundamental deltas combined, or any 252d window on $roa/$roe/$return, landed at 0.869-0.882 coverage.

Stop submitting CS_ZSCORE times CS_ZSCORE products. Both died on the cheap screen (leverage x TS_RANK($dollar_volume,63) at 0.57, 5d return reversal x $roe at 0.59). The accepted mixed factors use a cross-sectional fundamental rank as the base and a raw price ratio as the multiplier.

Pure price-geometry expressions with no fundamental field were the worst cheap-screen scores of the round (0.36 and 0.41). Do not send TS_MAX/TS_MIN/high-low range constructions unless a fundamental score leads the expression.

$accrual_gap times a normalized intraday range is this island's best vein (3.570 and 2.250 accepted). Extend it by varying the window structure of the range and its normalizer (2/5/21 day mixes), not by swapping the denominator's scale, which returned rho 0.839 against an archived sibling.

Re-dressing an archived factor never clears correlation: raw $roa against RANK($roa) is 1.000, and attaching a strictly positive bounded range multiplier to RANK($roa) still leaves rho 0.860. To decorrelate from a single-field archived rank, subtract a second cross-sectional rank or change sign structure instead of multiplying.

Price-scaling a fundamental and adding a plain quality rank works ($book_per_share/$open with $roe scored 3.155), but pairing a price-scaled fundamental with a 252d volatility term failed coverage at 0.869. Keep the second leg a contemporaneous cross-sectional rank.

Crossover needs a real subtree splice. Two proposals scored only 2 shared nodes because they wrapped a whole parent in a fresh multiplier; each parent should contribute a named field plus its own transform.
Keep a within-round proposal ledger for the $roa and $accrual_gap templates. A roa-delta minus return-mean pair was proposed twice and burned a slot as a duplicate.

prompt:
You are keeping a short working memory for a factor search on US large-cap
equities, fitted on 2000 to 2013.

Below is what happened in the round just finished on this island: which
proposals were accepted into the archive with their fitness, and which were
rejected with the reason. Fitness is a t-statistic of the mean daily rank IC,
scaled by year-to-year stability and charged for complexity and turnover.

ACCEPTED
  fitness   2.275  niche fast/fundamental/low  CS_RANK($operating_margin * $asset_turnover) - CS_RANK($leverage)
  fitness   3.155  niche medium/mixed/low  CS_RANK($book_per_share / ($open + 1e-8)) + CS_RANK($roe)
  fitness   1.589  niche fast/fundamental/low  RANK(TS_DELTA($roa, 126))
  fitness   3.570  niche fast/mixed/low  CS_RANK($accrual_gap) * ($high - $low) / (TS_MAX($high, 21) - $low + 1e-8)
  fitness   2.250  niche slow/mixed/low  CS_RANK($accrual_gap) * (TS_MAX($high, 2) - $low) / (TS_SUM($high - $low, 5) + 1e-8)

REJECTED
  -CS_RANK(TS_DELTA($leverage, 126)) - CS_RANK(TS_DELTA($accrual_gap, 126))
      cheap_screen: |t| 0.64 < 1.00 on the cheap window
  CS_RANK($roa - TS_MEAN($roa, 252)) - CS_RANK($accrual_gap)
      coverage: 0.871 < 0.90
  CS_RANK($earnings_per_share / ($open + 1e-8)) - CS_RANK(TS_STD($return, 252))
      coverage: 0.869 < 0.90
  CS_RANK(TS_DELTA($roa, 63)) - CS_RANK(TS_MEAN($return, 63))
      duplicate: already proposed in this run
  -CS_ZSCORE(TS_MEAN($return, 5)) * CS_RANK($roe)
      cheap_screen: |t| 0.59 < 1.00 on the cheap window
  -CS_ZSCORE(CS_RANK($leverage)) * CS_ZSCORE(TS_RANK($dollar_volume, 63))
      cheap_screen: |t| 0.57 < 1.00 on the cheap window
  CS_ZSCORE(TS_DELTA($asset_turnover, 126)) + CS_ZSCORE(TS_DELTA($operating_margin, 126))
      coverage: 0.882 < 0.90
  CS_RANK($roe / (TS_STD($roe, 252) + 1e-8))
      coverage: 0.871 < 0.90
  CS_RANK($accrual_gap) * (($high - $low) / ($open * TS_STD($return, 126) + 1e-8))
      correlation: |rho| 0.839 >= 0.80 against `CS_RANK($accrual_gap) * CS_RANK(($high - $low) / ($open + 1e-8))`
  CS_RANK((TS_MAX($high, 2) - TS_MIN($low, 21)) / (TS_SUM($high - $low, 21) + 1e-8))
      cheap_screen: |t| 0.41 < 1.00 on the cheap window
  CS_DEMEAN(RANK($roa)) * (TS_MAX($high, 21) - $high) / (TS_MEAN($high, 21) - TS_MIN($low, 21) + 1e-8)
      correlation: |rho| 0.860 >= 0.80 against `RANK($roa)`
  CS_DEMEAN(RANK($roa)) * (TS_MAX($high, 2) - $high) / (TS_MEAN($high, 21) - TS_MIN($low, 2) + 1e-8)
      cheap_screen: |t| 0.36 < 1.00 on the cheap window
  RANK($roa) * (TS_MEAN($high, 21) - $open) / (TS_MEAN($high, 21) - $low + 1e-8)
      crossover_not_a_fusion: shares only 2 nodes with `RANK($roa)`
  -CS_DEMEAN(RANK($roa)) * CS_DEMEAN(CS_RANK(TS_MEAN($dollar_volume, 21)))
      crossover_not_a_fusion: shares only 2 nodes with `RANK($roa)`
  $roa
      correlation: |rho| 1.000 >= 0.80 against `RANK($roa)`

Write at most 8 short rules that would make the next round better.
A useful rule is specific and actionable: "correlations between price and volume
over windows under 5 days were rejected for low coverage" beats "prefer robust
factors". Do not restate the hard limits, which are already enforced. Do not
propose expressions here.
